name: Origin UI
notes: REBRANDED: Origin UI was acquired by COSS (Cal.com). originui.com and the repo origin-space/originui now redirect: the site to https://coss.com/ui and the repo to cosscom/coss (10.5k stars). The original Origin UI is preserved as a MIT-licensed 'legacy snapshot' inside the monorepo at apps/origin, live at https://coss.com/origin (verified 200). LICENSE: the cosscom/coss repo default license is AGPL-3.0, but LICENSING.md and apps/origin/LICENSE.md explicitly keep apps/origin (and apps/ui) under the original MIT license, so the copyable components are MIT. Legacy status: 'support and maintenance are limited' per its README; active development moved to the successor COSS UI (coss.com/ui, Base UI-based, 55 components / 508 particles) - catalog that separately if needed. CATALOG: 30 category pages documenting 599 unique component variants (604 page references; 5 variants appear on two pages, e.g. upload buttons under both Button and File upload). Individual registry items are named comp-01..comp-599 (the old button-01 style names are gone); docs pages are per category, so each entry here is a variant family. The registry (https://coss.com/origin/r/registry.json, 646 items) also ships 41 shadcn-style base UI primitives (accordion, button, calendar, select, ...), 5 hooks (use-file-upload, use-toast, use-character-limit, use-pagination, use-slider-with-input) and utils, which the variants depend on; they have no standalone docs pages. Install variants: pnpm dlx / yarn dlx / bunx --bun shadcn@latest add https://coss.com/origin/r/<name>.json (site default tab is pnpm; <name> can be a category primitive like button.json or a variant like comp-01.json). Old originui.com/r/*.json URLs are NOT preserved (redirect to coss.com/ui homepage).
